text:
maria: Quick sync — catalog launch dress rehearsal tomorrow 10:00 PT. Last-call for navis-7b ingestion: licensing, perf-profile, and owners. @aj @liam @sofia @george please confirm canary windows and any blockers.

aj: I can own the canary. Suggest 2-hour window 11:30-13:30 PT, start at 30% -> 80% if metrics OK. Which routes will be in the canary?

maria: Primary route is /generate-open; secondary is /chat-guest. Propose we only enable /generate-open for canary to limit blast radius.

liam: Perf quicknotes from staging (A100): median 240ms (baseline 215ms), p95 620ms (baseline 500ms). Saw spikes correlated with KV cache cold starts — attention kernel hotspot around step 3.

sofia: Legal check: model license is Apache-2.0, no copyleft flags. Need a redistribution notice in catalog metadata and an internal CLA note for weight redistribution. I can draft that.

george: Infra: autoscaler defaults are 1-5. For canary set min=1 max=2. Recommend SLO guard: if p95 > 700ms for 3 consecutive minutes -> rollback. Also we need resource limit tweaks for int8 runtime.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: navis-7b image built (sha: abcd1234). Canary job queued for 2623460400.

aj: Ack deploy-bot. I'll reserve the slot and coordinate the rollout message.

liam: Quick CR ping: PR #4521 updates perf-profile and int8 quant config. @maria can you review perf notes? Also note I set default batch_size=8 in config — may be too high for low-latency routes.

maria: Will review tonight. If we care latency for /generate-open reduce default batch_size to 4. Also need a perf_profile JSON in the catalog: {"model":"navis-7b","quant":"int8","median_ms":"240","p95_ms":"620"} (draft)

sofia: I added a redistribution_note draft in catalog PR #4822 and the license blob. Will route to security for signoff.

aj: One more check — embeddings dims for navis-7b? Clients expect 1024.

liam: Embeddings are actually 1536 in the current artifact. That explains some downstream consumer errors in staging.

maria: Oof. Action items: liam -> update ingestion transformer to accept 1536 and add conversion/migration; aj -> hold canary until embeddings shape is resolved; sofia -> keep legal doc moving. george -> if embeddings change, we need a migration flag + dual-serving for 48h.

george: We can serve v1/v2 behind a router with header flag for 48h. I'll add an infra toggle and migration plan.

aj: Holding canary. Will update schedule to target 10:30 PT start if ingestion migration lands by then.

liam: I'll open PR for ingestion transformer with unit tests and a compatibility shim. ETA: merge by 2623457600.

maria: Perfect. I'm pausing the full launch until embedding migration and ingestion tests pass. New tentative plan: pause canary, target 10:30 PT start with migration in place, owners: liam (ingest), aj (canary), sofia (legal), george (infra). I'll update the launch checklist and post final call 30m before start. :thumbsup:

aj: Ack. Ping me for the rollout message when ready.

liam: Will post PR link when ready and add integration smoke tests for embeddings.

maria: Thanks everyone — this thread is the single source for last-minute asks. Post small updates here rather than new threads.

legal-bot: legal-bot: Reminder — any redistribution notice added to catalog must include the reference ticket number and a short summary (max 300 chars).

maria: Noted. I'll add the ticket ID in the catalog metadata.

maria: Closing loop for now. If no new blockers by 2623457600 we proceed with ingestion PR review and reconvene at 09:45 PT for final signoff.
